note: The script asks for four graphics: the top text and three first-name supers, Anissa, Ana and Mackinnon. Every other row is captions only, and the end card is Watsi's own.

mg.title: Voicemail top text
mg.cue: Top text from frame 1, top third: “A voicemail for a stranger.” Lato Bold, white, soft shadow. Cut on. Stays to 00:05.5.
mg.use: Top text from frame 1, top third. The script says cut on, so start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05.5.

mg.title: Anissa name super
mg.cue: Name super “Anissa” on the first word, lower left, above the captions, large. First name only. 2 s.
mg.use: Name super on her first word, for 2 seconds. Move it lower left, above the captions, and keep it large.

mg.title: Ana name super
mg.cue: Name super “Ana” on the first word, lower left, above the captions, large. First name only. 2 s.
mg.use: Name super on her first word, for 2 seconds. Move it lower left, above the captions, and keep it large.

mg.title: Mackinnon name super
mg.cue: Name super “Mackinnon” on “Thanks for putting your trust”, late, lower left, large. First name only.
mg.use: Bring it on late, when she says “Thanks for putting your trust”, and hold it to the end of the row at 01:33. Move it lower left, above the captions, and keep it large.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: “Tell us your story.” in September Spirit, then watsi.org/who-gives, lowercase, Lato. Nothing else.
mg.src: Watsi's own end card words from the script (watsi.org, the Who Gives close, or the Watsi x AYH lines). Watsi's scripts say no logo lockup.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 01:33 after the last line and hold it to the end. The script wants Tell us your story. in September Spirit on the Who Gives gradient: swap the font and background if you have them.
